purpose: Mechanically validate externally authored candidate-blind A6 authority/discharge gold packets without creating or inferring those two labels inside ORION.

required_exact_fields: packet_id resolves to exactly one frozen intake packet
stratum exactly matches the frozen intake packet
split exactly matches the frozen intake packet
source_family_id, normalized_organization_lineage, artifact_lineage_id exactly match the frozen intake packet
before_version_id and after_version_id exactly match the frozen intake packet
before_sha256 and after_sha256 exactly match the frozen intake packet and differ
license_or_rights_receipt_id, external_custody_receipt_id, adjudicator_assignment_receipt_id exactly match the frozen intake packet
candidate_visible_packet_sha256 exactly matches the frozen intake packet

gold_label_rule: Every packet carries BOTH labels adjudicated separately; each label states its own target, rationale, evidence_refs and an explicit disagreement record.
adjudicator_receives: the candidate-visible packet (identified by candidate_visible_packet_sha256) carrying only target-relevant scientific coordinates and the terminal alphabet
disagreement_rule: Per gold label: if disagreement_observed is true, either a non-empty resolution is required or the label target must be CANNOT_CHECK (unresolved authority is CANNOT_CHECK). If disagreement_observed is false, resolution must be null/empty. Notes are always required.
batch_rule: packet_id must be unique across all validated gold packets and each gold packet binds exactly one frozen intake packet; unadjudicated intake packets are reported, never filled in.
